jobs.title: Praktikant til full stack-udvikling og digitale forretningsprocesser
jobs.location: Aarhus Municipality, Central Denmark Region, Denmark
jobs.description:
Er du studerende med interesse for full stack-udvikling og digitale forretningsprocesser?

Vi søger en engageret praktikant, der kan binde vores digitale løsninger sammen med de daglige processer. Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med de kolleger, der bruger systemerne.
Du indsamler deres behov og omsætter dem til løsninger, fra brugerfladen og helt ned i data og integrationer. Opgaverne er reelle, og de løsninger, du er med til at udvikle, bliver taget i brug i virksomheden.
I efteråret 2025 implementerede vi Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central i en tekstiltilpasset løsning. Siden har vi udviklet vores egne applikationer oven på ERP-systemet, og de understøtter i dag en stor del af de daglige arbejdsgange. Med fundamentet på plads er vi nu klar til en række optimeringsprojekter, hvor du kommer til at spille en aktiv rolle.

Opgaverne vil bl.a. omfatte:

udvikling af nye applikationer og videreudvikling af vores interne portal.
udvikling af integrationer og rapportering baseret på data fra ERP-systemet.
samarbejde med brugerne, så systemet og de værktøjer, vi udvikler, bliver brugt bedst muligt.
dokumentation og procesforbedringer.

Vi er i gang med at udvikle en kommunikationsplatform til vores leverandører og vi vil på længere sigt udvikle en til kunderne. Her får du indflydelse på både arkitekturen, arbejdsgange og den endelige løsning.

DET TEKNISKE:

Vores løsninger bygger på en Microsoft-baseret platform. Kernen er udviklet i .NET og vores webapplikation bygget i React.
Data fra Business Central synkroniseres løbende til vores egen SQL-database. Via API'er integrerer vi med eksterne partnere, fx fragtfirmaer, og det samme fundament bruges til overblik og rapportering.
Al vores kode ligger på GitHub. Vi arbejder aktivt med Github og al test og udrulning er automatiseret. AI er en integreret del af vores udviklingsproces. Vi bruger AI-værktøjer aktivt til kodning, review og problemløsning, og du lærer at bruge dem effektivt og ansvarligt. Du behøver ikke kende alle værktøjerne på forhånd. Du får erfaring med hele forløbet fra idé og analyse til en løsning i drift.

OM OS:

Vi er et lille, dedikeret team, der hjælper outdoor-brands med at udvikle og producere specialtilpasset beklædning – især inden for jagt. Vores styrke ligger i nørderiet: vi elsker at fordybe os i materialer, funktioner og detaljer, der gør forskellen ude i naturen.
I virksomheden har vi gode IT-kompetencer i form af en fuldtidsansat IT-arkitekt og en studiemedhjælper som begge kender virksomheden og selv har været i praktik ved CD Company. Så der er rum for både forretningsmæssig- og fagligudvikling i praktikken.
Hos os møder du en uformel atmosfære, hvor der altid er kaffe på kanden og snacks i skålene. Vi tror på, at de gode løsninger vokser frem i fællesskab, gennem åben diskussion og masser af energi.

OM DIG:

er i gang med en relevant IT-uddannelse, fx softwareudvikling, datamatiker, IT-arkitektur eller lign.
har kendskab til programmering og interesse for full stack-udvikling, API'er og integrationer.
er interesseret i ERP-systemer og i, hvordan IT kan understøtte og forbedre forretningens processer.
er nysgerrig på AI og moderne udviklingsværktøjer og har lyst til at bruge dem i praksis.
trives med at arbejde tæt på brugerne og kan omsætte deres behov til tekniske løsninger.
tager ansvar for dine opgaver og kan både arbejde selvstændigt og i et lille team.

Opstart primo januar/start februar 2027

jobs.title: Senior Application Developer (Capital Markets) (Contract)
jobs.description:
About Maybank Securities

Maybank Securities, a leading brokerage and investment bank with a reach extending across ASEAN, the UK and the US, offers a comprehensive suite of services. These include corporate finance & advisory, navigating debt and equity capital markets, derivatives trading, brokerage and research for both retail and institutional investors, and prime brokerage.

Job Description:

We are seeking a highly motivated and hands-on Application Developer to join our Solution Development team. The role will focus on the development, enhancement, and support of strategic in-house platforms supporting Front Office, Risk Management, Clearing, Operations, Regulatory Reporting, and Business Intelligence functions.

The successful candidate will play a key role in extending our internal development capabilities, working closely with business and technology stakeholders to deliver scalable solutions across multiple asset classes and markets. You will participate throughout the software development lifecycle, from requirements gathering and solution design through implementation, deployment, and ongoing support.

The responsibility of this role includes:

Design, develop, integrate, and maintain enterprise applications supporting trading, risk, operations, and reporting functions.
Develop new capabilities and enhancements using .NET Framework, C#, and MSSQL technologies.
Collaborate with business users, product managers, operations teams, and technology stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver effective solutions.
Analyse business processes and identify opportunities to automate manual workflows and improve operational efficiency.
Design and optimize database structures, SQL queries, stored procedures, and reporting solutions.
Perform impact assessments and evaluate technical risks associated with system changes.
Participate in application integration initiatives across internal and third-party platforms.
Troubleshoot production issues and provide ongoing application support and maintenance.
Maintain technical documentation, system specifications, and solution designs.
Follow software engineering best practices, including version control, code reviews, testing, release management, and change governance.
Contribute to strategic technology initiatives supporting business growth, risk management, and regulatory requirements.
Champion the organization's values, culture, and customer-first mindset while fostering a collaborative and high-performance working environment.

Qualification requirement:

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
3 to 8 years of experience in application development within financial services, capital markets, investment banking, or trading environments.
Strong hands-on development experience with: C#, .NET Framework / .NET, Microsoft SQL Server (MSSQL), Stored Procedures and Database Performance Tuning, GitHub and source control practices.
Good understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) methodologies and software engineering principles.
Experience developing and supporting business-critical applications in a production environment.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work independently.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
Knowledge of capital markets products including Equities, FX, Futures, Options, Fixed Income, and Derivatives.
Understanding of front-to-back trade lifecycle and post-trade processing workflows.
Experience integrating with broker, exchange, market data, clearing, or settlement platforms.

Good to have:

Familiarity with FIX Protocol and electronic trading connectivity.
Experience working with large-scale reporting, business intelligence, or data management platforms.
Exposure to cloud technologies, APIs, and modern application architecture is advantageous.

This is a 12-month contract role with potential for renewal based on performance and business needs.

We regret that only short-listed candidates will be notified.

jobs.title: Senior Analyst Programmer (HRMS/Payroll)
jobs.description:
Meet Unit4. With over 40 years of heritage, we’re an agile, fast growing, Cloud company that is on a mission to redefine Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) for mid-market people-centric organisations.

With our innovative, self-driving, adaptive and intuitive software, our customers can spend more time on meaningful high-value work.

At the heart of what we do lies a simple yet profound purpose: Improve how people work by focusing on what truly matters.
— A powerful statement that enables different priorities for different people.

We’re shaping how work should feel
, and we empower our people by providing them with the right tools to achieve the autonomy they need - it's what makes us unique.

Job Description

Responsibilities:

We are seeking a highly accountable and proactive Senior Analyst Programmer to own the technical development, security, and maintenance of our core Human Resources Management System (HRMS).

As the Senior Analyst Programmer, you will be accountable for conducting comprehensive system analysis and development across multiple HR systems—Time Management (TMS), Payroll Management (PMS), Leave Management (LMS), and additional HR modules.
Your key responsibilities include:

Developing software functions in strict adherence to organizational architectural standards and design principles, ensuring compliance and structural integrity;
Developing and executing unit tests and implementing code for user stories in accordance with test-driven development methodology;
Operating within an agile framework utilizing Scrum methodology, including active participation in daily sprint meetings, development and implementation, and test case review;
Conducting rigorous root cause analysis of system defects to deliver comprehensive and sustainable solutions for all identified issues.

Qualifications

**Qualifications:**

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology or related field
Minimum 5 years of professional experience in software development and systems analysis
Advanced technical proficiency in C#, VB.Net, .Net Framework, T-SQL, and DevExpress reporting tools, DevOps and API
Comprehensive knowledge of regional payroll systems and regulations across Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, Philippines, China, Vietnam, Macau, Taiwan, and Hong Kong

Demonstrated expertise in Payroll Processing, Time & Attendance, Leave Management, Claims Processing best practices
Thorough understanding of HRMS legislation, regulations, and industry best practices
Proven analytical and problem-solving capabilities with expertise in debugging and system optimization
Professional experience with agile development methodologies, including Scrum and Test-Driven Development
Fluency in English language, both written and verbal
Commitment to continuous improvement and collaborative design decision-making

Additional Information

Who we are?

We are a people-first community that nurtures all the areas that surround your working experience. With us, you’ll be surrounded by a high-performance team that supports your authentic self and celebrates your uniqueness.

We believe that ‘How work should feel’ is an evolving statement. Work goes beyond tasks and everyday responsibilities it’s about feeling valued, empowered, promoted, impactful, seen, and appreciated.

We are reimagining how work makes people feel.

What we offer?

a culture built on trust and accountability - giving you the freedom and autonomy to be successful and make an impact
balance - with our Flexible Leave Paid Time Off policy, remote working opportunities, Global Wellbeing Days, and other great benefits
growth opportunities - we provide the tools and guidance required so that you can focus on what really matters to you and so, ultimately, you can achieve your best work
talented colleagues, role models and mentors - work, learn and be inspired by some of the best talent in the software industry
a commitment to sustainability - with initiatives such as our Environmental, Social, and Governance strategy and Act4Good programme
a safe and inclusive working environment – supported by our Employee Resource Groups, which are open to all.

Our commitment to equity

Unit4 is committed to ensuring equal opportunity for everyone. We make our hiring decisions solely based on skills, qualifications, and our current business needs. We know that diversity brings fresh perspectives, ideas, and solutions to our company. This is the essence of our culture. We also welcome and encourage people who are pregnant and/or parents-to-be to apply. If you would like to know more about our commitment to diversity, visit our blogs:

Our focus to DEI remains central to who we are
Inclusive hiring at Unit4: Building equal opportunities for all

Subject to applicable local laws, such security checks may require disclosure of personal information including criminal record declaration, right to work, personal identification and work history. No worries though – we'll handle it according to local privacy laws and keep your info safe. Questions? Feel free to reach out!
